info.title: PromptMatrix API
info.description: Enterprise prompt governance infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline control plane for AI agent swarms.

get.description:
Runtime endpoint. Called by agents, n8n, LangChain, curl — anything.
Optimised for low latency via Upstash + anyio threadpooling for DB calls.

post.description: Backward compatibility endpoint for OSS SDKs to record telemetry in the SaaS backend.

Invalidate a refresh token by adding its jti claim to a Redis blocklist.
TTL matches the token's remaining lifetime — keys auto-expire, no cleanup needed.
If Redis is unavailable, logout is still acknowledged (fail-open for UX).

Change the authenticated user's password.
Used by the accept-invite flow (invited users log in with temp password, then set a real one).
Verifies a user's email address using a signed JWT token.

get.description: List all versions for a prompt — used by the dashboard version history panel.
List all pending approval requests for the org.
Alias for GET /api/v1/approvals — /queue suffix for dashboard compatibility.

post.description: Create a new project with default or custom environments. Requires admin+ role.
Add a new environment to an existing project. Requires admin+ role.

get.description: List environments for a specific project (IDOR-protected).
Returns the caller's current organisation and membership info.

post.description:
Razorpay webhook endpoint.

Required Razorpay events to subscribe to:
  - payment.captured (one-time Founding Member purchase)

get.description:
Returns a Razorpay Payment Link for the requested plan.

IMPORTANT: Before returning the URL we store the user's email as
org.billing_email so the webhook can find the org by email as a
fallback when Razorpay Payment Pages don't populate notes.org_id.
Returns the current billing plan and limits for the user's org.
Returns usage of limits (seats, prompts, API calls) for the user's org.

Live counter stats — used by landing page to display:
  - Remaining founding member spots
  - Total waitlist signups by tier

Called by the landing page every 30 seconds via JS polling.
Rate limited: 10 requests/minute per IP to prevent DB hammering.

post.description:
Capture waitlist interest for non-founding tiers.
Duplicate emails are silently ignored (idempotent).
Rate limited: 5 requests/minute per IP to prevent DB spam.

Initiates password reset. Always returns 200 — never reveals
whether the email exists (prevents user enumeration).

Validates token and sets new password. Token is single-use
(jti is blocklisted in Redis after first use).

get.description:
Health check endpoint. Probes the database with a lightweight SELECT 1.
Returns db_status so uptime monitors catch DB connectivity failures early.
Production-safe: never leaks env name or error details to the outside.
Alias for /api/status — satisfies Vercel uptime monitors and load balancer probes.

Public live-counter endpoint — no auth required.
Safe: returns only aggregate counts, zero PII, zero internal config.

Intended uses:
  - Embed in launch tweets: '🟢 PromptMatrix Founders: 3/100 claimed'
  - GitHub README badge via shields.io JSON endpoint
  - Product Hunt launch post counter
  - External monitoring scripts

Response:
  {"founders": 3, "total": 100, "remaining": 97, "sold_out": false,
   "oss": "https://github.com/PromptMatrix/Promptmatrix"}
